query: Please develop an online training website to provide ISTQB advanced level test analyst training courses. The website should have functionalities for registration, login, course browsing, online teaching, assignment submission, and grade evaluation. Users should be able to register and log in to the website, browse and select courses, attend online classes, submit assignments, and view grade evaluations. The course content should include topics such as test design techniques, test management, and test automation. Define the background as rosy brown and components as brown.
